brief.client: Solace (fictional — concept work): a wellness and sleep brand — app, sleep accessories and wind-down rituals
brief.goal: Rebrand reveal for the agency's case study and the client's launch deck: show the whole identity system as one living brand book in 18 s
brief.audience: Brand and marketing leads choosing an agency; Solace's own team and partners adopting the new identity
brief.message: A calm, considered identity — one crescent mark that scales from an app icon to a tote
brief.tone: Quiet, precise, editorial: generous whitespace, slow confident easing, paper-like layers, one warm accent
